name: Emping
description: Bitter crackers pounded from melinjo nuts and fried.

tcm.note: Outside the classical record; fried nut cracker; read as warming.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; ushna and guru.

histamine.note: Nut-based and fried. Melinjo raises uric acid, which is a separate caution for gout.
